• and honest wrapping at every width

The slate types learned their richest tricks in the terminal first; this section proves the browser kept up. Every exhibit below renders from the same document on every surface: a contribution calendar that dual-encodes its quantiles, a matrix with Σ marginals and exact values, a stat tile with a dim denominator, and a chart whose y-axis reads 45.5M instead of 45500000.
